learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill: Jobsite Tape / Label / Marking Conventions.
notes: Production-specific temporary marking literacy; no universal color code. Planned HR06 research precursor retained for provenance; canonical live learner identity is C-FLD-MARK at courses/field-skill-jobsite-tape-label-marking.html.

learner_facing_text: Tape and temporary marks are ordinary production communication tools, but exact color meanings and conventions are production-, venue-, employer- or department-specific rather than universal.
notes: Do not publish a national spike-tape color code. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-MARKING-LABELING to canonical live course C-FLD-MARK on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-jobsite-tape-label-marking.html.

learner_facing_text: A beginner production-marking task does not authorize obscuring, replacing or reinterpreting manufacturer, regulatory, inspection, load-rating, electrical, fire-safety or other controlled labels.
notes: Controlled labels remain owned by the applicable manufacturer/employer/regulatory process. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-MARKING-LABELING to canonical live course C-FLD-MARK on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-jobsite-tape-label-marking.html.

learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill: Ground-Supported Scenery / Flat / Wagon Movement Under Direction.
notes: Hand-moved ground scenery only; fly/automation/powered mechanisms excluded. Planned HR06 research precursor retained for provenance; canonical live learner identity is C-FLD-SCENERY at courses/field-skill-scenery-flat-wagon-movement.html.

learner_facing_text: Flats, wagons and other ground-supported scenic pieces are established stagecraft categories and may be moved by hand under the responsible scenic/stage authority when the piece and show state are actually released for movement.
notes: Physical movability does not imply release to move. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-SCENERY-MOVEMENT to canonical live course C-FLD-SCENERY on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-scenery-flat-wagon-movement.html.

learner_facing_text: General scenery-movement learning does not authorize fly-system, automation, motorized scenic machinery, overhead attachment, structural-bracing acceptance, load calculations or unassigned show-cue operation.
notes: No specialist mechanism operation is taught. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-SCENERY-MOVEMENT to canonical live course C-FLD-SCENERY on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-scenery-flat-wagon-movement.html.

learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill/Orientation: Loading Dock / Ramp / Trailer Handoff Awareness.
notes: Pedestrian/material-flow awareness only; powered-equipment and driver/load authority excluded. Planned HR06 research precursor retained for provenance; canonical live learner identity is C-FLD-DOCK at courses/field-skill-dock-ramp-trailer-handoff-awareness.html.

learner_facing_text: Loading docks and powered-equipment traffic create changing pedestrian/material-flow hazards; general hands should remain within the assigned flow, preserve visibility and stop when the dock/ramp/trailer or equipment interaction is unclear.
notes: Awareness only; no powered-equipment procedure. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-DOCK-HANDOFF to canonical live course C-FLD-DOCK on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-dock-ramp-trailer-handoff-awareness.html.

learner_facing_text: Dock/trailer awareness does not authorize forklift, powered pallet-jack, MEWP, vehicle or trailer operation, dockboard acceptance, cargo securement, truck-pack design, or driver/load acceptance.
notes: External employer/regulatory/driver/load authority remains separate. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-DOCK-HANDOFF to canonical live course C-FLD-DOCK on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-dock-ramp-trailer-handoff-awareness.html.
